note: Cambodia: a foreign employee named in an enterprise's patent tax certificate, and a self-employed foreigner, must hold the Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training's work permit and employment card, applied for online (Notification No. 110/23 of 28 December 2023, under Prakas 195 of 2014). No performers' exemption was found, so no days. Read from a law firm's note.

sources.title: Tilleke & Gibbins, Cambodia Sets New Work Permit Rules for Foreign Employees
sources.said: A foreign employee whose name is stated in an enterprise’s patent tax certificate must hold a foreign work permit and an employment card. Self-employed individuals must hold a foreign work permit and an employment card.
